prompt.en: What is the border between Canada and the United States traditionally known as?
prompt.fr: Comment appelle-t-on traditionnellement la frontière entre le Canada et les États-Unis?

options.fr: La plus longue frontière non défendue au monde.

explanation.en: Millions of Canadians and Americans cross it safely each year, which is why it carries that name.
explanation.fr: Des millions de Canadiens et d'Américains la traversent en toute sécurité chaque année, d'où ce nom.

source.quote: Millions of Canadians and Americans cross every year and in safety what is traditionally known as “the world’s longest undefended border.”

verification.evidence: Millions of Canadians and Americans cross every year and in safety what is traditionally known as “the world’s longest undefended border.”
